string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: NEW: Organizer — automatically groups your apps into folders (Games, Social, Photo & Video, and more) based on what each app actually declares itself to be
Every folder can be pinned as a one-tap shortcut on your real home screen
Any app\'s folder can be changed by hand if the automatic grouping guesses wrong
Honest by design: no app — ours included — can read or rearrange your home screen\'s actual layout, so we built the closest thing that\'s actually possible instead of faking it
